messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "orange juice"
set: ["orange juice", "fruit juice", "grapefruit juice", "mix with apple juice", "mix with 4 ounces (half a cup) of water, ginger ale, lemon or lime soda, lemonade, or orange juice", "avoid drinking more than 1.2 liters of grapefruit juice each day", "oral granules should be mixed with applesauce or apple juice when taken by mouth", "if giving through a nasogastric (ng) or gastrostomy tube, mix only with apple juice", "you may mix the concentrated solution with juice or a soft food such as applesauce", "mix powder form with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking", "avoid taking with fruit juices or vitamin C at the same time", "liquid", "grapefruit", "may mix liquid with water, milk, baby formula, fruit juice, or ginger ale", "oral liquid", "drink all of the mixture right away"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
